events.title: ucp repository created on GitHub
UCP launched at NRF; release v2026-01-11
events.detail: Co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target and Walmart; over 20 endorsers. The v2026-01-11 git tag and GitHub release were created on 2026-01-23.

events.title: Release v2026-01-23 (breaking refactor)
Senator Warren letter on Gemini checkout and UCP
events.detail: Letter date as reported by eWeek on 2026-02-05; the senate.gov copy was blocked.

events.title: UCP checkout live in the US for Etsy and Wayfair in AI Mode and Gemini
Request and response signing merged (PR 156)
Google update: cart, catalog and identity linking for loyalty benefits
events.detail: Primary Google post; Commerce Inc, Salesforce and Stripe named as upcoming implementers.

events.title: Release v2026-04-08: cart, catalog, signing, signals
Shopping Tech Council expands to 16 seats
events.detail: New members from Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Stripe and Salesforce.

events.title: Stripe joins the Governing Council; AP2 donated to FIDO
Universal Cart announced; uses UCP for checkout
events.detail: A Google product, not the protocol.

events.title: UCP checkout in ads; Canada and Australia planned, then the UK
Web Bot Auth interop merged (PR 483)
Food Tech Council formed
Lodging Tech Council formed
Release v2026-08-25: actions, 3DS2, split payments, AP2 rename
Payments Tech Council formed
UCP sessions at the W3C and GS1 workshop
Reported automatic enrollment of US Shopify merchants in Google native checkout
Draft lodging booking capability merged on main (PR 780)
events.detail: Merged 2026-09-24, announced 2026-09-25; in no release as of 2026-10-20.

events.title: Contributing guide: Enhancement Proposals, maturity levels, breaking-change rules
events.detail: Capabilities move through Working Draft, Candidate and Stable; a breaking change needs Governing Council approval and two weeks' notice; vendor work starts under com.{vendor}.

events.title: Universal Cart launches in the US; checkout through UCP
events.detail: Across Google Search and the Gemini app; merchants remain seller of record. A Google product, not the protocol.

events.title: Draft webhook signing change merged on main (PR 659)
events.detail: webhook-id and webhook-timestamp join the required signed components; businesses retry with the original Webhook-Id and Webhook-Timestamp; platforms should deduplicate on Webhook-Id. In no release as of 2026-10-20.

events.title: Release tags v2026-08-25 and v2026-04-08 moved to include backports
events.detail: Moved on 2026-10-22 or 2026-10-23. v2026-08-25 now points at 87dd4b1 (cart_id patch, rich media variants and other backports) instead of the original cut cd78fb3; v2026-04-08 gained permalink and Web Bot Auth interop.

events.title: Google's UCP FAQ rewritten: new User-Agent, signed requests, ASN rules
events.detail: Default User-Agent Google-Shopping-Merchant-Integration; verification by mutual TLS, ES256 RFC 9421 signatures against the keys at ucp.goog and source ASN; reverse DNS no longer offered. Changed between 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-30; last updated 2026-11-03.

events.title: Ask capability backported into the 2026-08-25 release branch (PR 1024)
events.detail: Approved by the Shopping Tech Council on 2026-10-30; ucp.dev serves dev.ucp.common.ask as part of 2026-08-25, but the git tag does not include it. Shopify said on 2026-11-06 that Ask is live across its storefronts.

events.title: Shopify opens Google direct checkout to stores anywhere selling to the US, Canada or Australia
events.detail: Shopify's help center wording, seen by 2026-11-03 (changed after 2026-10-20). Australia is Shopify's statement; Google's posts announce Canada only.

events.title: UCP direct checkout launches for Canadian shoppers in AI Mode and Gemini
events.detail: Google Canada names lululemon, select Shopify merchants, Shoppers Drug Mart and Simons; retailers remain seller of record. First UCP checkout outside the US in Google's posts; Universal Cart is not part of it.

events.title: Microsoft's Copilot Checkout page drops its no-commission answer
events.detail: Removed between 2026-11-04 and about 2026-11-06 (archive captures, dating only); on 2026-11-14 PayPal no longer appears on the page either. The page makes no fee statement, which is not evidence of a new fee.

events.title: Draft Food Checkout capability merged on main (PR 897)
events.detail: dev.ucp.food.checkout with dev.ucp.food.fulfillment and dev.ucp.food.tip; announced by the Food Domain Tech Council on 2026-11-13. In no release as of 2026-11-14.

events.title: Personal Agent Protocol 1.0 ships a UCP extension co-authored by Shopify
events.detail: The standard, which Sierra announced with Meta on 2026-10-06 and which Meta and Sierra develop, finds the business and signs the user in, then leaves the shopping to UCP; it connects to UCP Ask. An outside standard, not part of UCP.
